items.en: to hold; to grasp; handlebar; classifier: handful, bundle, bunch

lessons.html:

Can or can't

Grammar focus: Potential complements: 听得懂 / 听不懂, 找不到

HSK 3 · 第29单元

Doing things to things

Grammar focus: 把 sentences

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我知道怎么解决这个问题。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào zěn me jiě jué zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: I know how to solve the problem.

sents.zh: 请找到问题的解决方法。
sents.p: qǐng zhǎo dào wèn tí de jiě jué fāng fǎ
sents.en: Please find a solution to the problem.

sents.zh: 想吃多少饼干就吃多少。
sents.p: xiǎng chī duō shǎo bǐng gān jiù chī duō shǎo
sents.en: Take as many cookies as you want.

sents.zh: 我不记得干了那样的事情。
sents.p: wǒ bù jì de gàn le nà yàng de shì qing
sents.en: I don't remember doing anything like that.

sents.zh: 关于那个你有什么看法？
sents.p: guān yú nà gè nǐ yǒu shén me kàn fǎ
sents.en: What do you think about it?

sents.zh: 这是一本关于星星的书。
sents.p: zhè shì yī běn guān yú xīng xing de shū
sents.en: This is a book about stars.

sents.zh: 她提前一小时完成了工作。
sents.p: tā tí qián yī xiǎo shí wán chéng le gōng zuò
sents.en: She finished her work an hour in advance.

sents.zh: 您可以在三天内完成吗？
sents.p: nín kě yǐ zài sān tiān nèi wán chéng ma
sents.en: Can you finish this in three days?

sents.zh: 你觉得明天天气会变好吗？
sents.p: nǐ jué de míng tiān tiān qì huì biàn hǎo ma
sents.en: Do you think the weather will be fine tomorrow?

sents.zh: 如果我们想，我们就能变。
sents.p: rú guǒ wǒ men xiǎng wǒ men jiù néng biàn
sents.en: We can change if we want to.

sents.zh: 他们在加拿大安家落户。
sents.p: tā men zài jiā ná dà ān jiā luò hù
sents.en: They settled in Canada.

sents.zh: 我们在下个加油站停一下。
sents.p: wǒ men zài xià gè jiā yóu zhàn tíng yī xià
sents.en: Let's stop at the next gas station.

sents.zh: 你的问题和我没有关系。
sents.p: nǐ de wèn tí hé wǒ méi yǒu guān xi
sents.en: Your problems don't concern me.

sents.zh: 他不再是以前的那个他了。
sents.p: tā bù zài shì yǐ qián de nà gè tā le
sents.en: He is not what he used to be.

sents.zh: 他比以前学得更努力了。
sents.p: tā bǐ yǐ qián xué de gēng nǔ lì le
sents.en: He studies much harder than before.

sents.zh: 这咖啡热得我没办法喝。
sents.p: zhè kā fēi rè de wǒ méi bàn fǎ hē
sents.en: This coffee is too hot for me to drink.

sents.zh: 她想到了一个好的解决办法。
sents.p: tā xiǎng dào le yī gè hǎo de jiě jué bàn fǎ
sents.en: She thought of a good solution.

sents.zh: 没发生什么特别的事。
sents.p: méi fā shēng shén me tè bié de shì
sents.en: Nothing special happened.

sents.zh: 我特别不喜欢她。
sents.p: wǒ tè bié bù xǐ huan tā
sents.en: I don't particularly like her.

sents.zh: 别的狗都没这只狗大。
sents.p: bié de gǒu dōu méi zhè zhǐ gǒu dà
sents.en: No other dog is bigger than this.

sents.zh: 我不需要你或别的人。
sents.p: wǒ bù xū yào nǐ huò bié de rén
sents.en: I don't need you or anybody else.

sents.zh: 为什么我们现在不能讲？
sents.p: wèi shén me wǒ men xiàn zài bù néng jiǎng
sents.en: Why can't we talk now?

sents.zh: 我每天工作时都讲法语。
sents.p: wǒ měi tiān gōng zuò shí dōu jiǎng fǎ yǔ
sents.en: I speak French every day at work.

sents.zh: 她一小时前离开了医院。
sents.p: tā yī xiǎo shí qián lí kāi le yī yuàn
sents.en: She left the hospital an hour ago.

sents.zh: 我们为什么不离开这里？
sents.p: wǒ men wèi shén me bù lí kāi zhè lǐ
sents.en: Why don't we get out of here?

sents.zh: 你真的以为我会帮你吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhēn de yǐ wéi wǒ huì bāng nǐ ma
sents.en: Did you really think I was going to help you?

sents.zh: 我可以为你调杯热饮料吗？
sents.p: wǒ kě yǐ wèi nǐ diào bēi rè yǐn liào ma
sents.en: Can I fix you a hot drink?

sents.zh: 你知道的越少越好，好吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào de yuè shǎo yuè hǎo hǎo ma
sents.en: The less you know, the better, OK?

sents.zh: 你看的书越多，你知道的越多。
sents.p: nǐ kàn de shū yuè duō nǐ zhī dào de yuè duō
sents.en: The more books you read, the more you'll know.

sents.zh: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng tí chū jiě jué wèn tí de fāng fǎ ma
sents.en: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?

sents.zh: 这种方法早已过时了。
sents.p: zhè zhǒng fāng fǎ zǎo yǐ guò shí le
sents.en: Those kinds of methods are out of date.

sents.zh: 您能把电视开小声点吗？
sents.p: nín néng bǎ diàn shì kāi xiǎo shēng diǎn ma
sents.en: Can you turn the TV down?

sents.zh: 您能把收音机开小声一点吗？
sents.p: nín néng bǎ shōu yīn jī kāi xiǎo shēng yī diǎn ma
sents.en: Could you turn down the radio?

sents.zh: 我们选她为我们队的队长。
sents.p: wǒ men xuǎn tā wèi wǒ men duì de duì zhǎng
sents.en: We elected her captain of our team.

sents.zh: 我想给我朋友选个礼物。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng gěi wǒ péng you xuǎn gè lǐ wù
sents.en: I want to pick out a present for my friend.

sents.zh: 她说的每句话都是事实。
sents.p: tā shuō de měi gōu huà dōu shì shì shí
sents.en: Whatever she says is true.

sents.zh: 我想知道这句话的意思。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng zhī dào zhè gōu huà de yì si
sents.en: I wonder what this phrase means.

sents.zh: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。
sents.p: tā zài yī xué jiè yǒu hěn dà de yǐng xiǎng lì
sents.en: He's very influential in the world of medicine.

sents.zh: 你的影响力是什么？
sents.p: nǐ de yǐng xiǎng lì shì shén me
sents.en: What are your influences?

sents.zh: 你真想让我马上到那里去吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhēn xiǎng ràng wǒ mǎ shàng dào nà li qù ma
sents.en: Do you really want me to go there right now?

sents.zh: 我必须马上和你说话。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū mǎ shàng hé nǐ shuō huà
sents.en: I have to speak with you immediately.

items.en: besides; apart from (... also...); in addition to

ex.zh: 除了一人，大家都回家了。
ex.p: chú le yī rén dà jiā dōu huí jiā le
ex.en: Except for one person, everybody went home.

ex.zh: 我总是在上学前先吃饭。
ex.p: wǒ zǒng shì zài shàng xué qián xiān chī fàn
ex.en: I always eat before going to school.

ex.zh: 我没有总是这样做。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu zǒng shì zhè yàng zuò
ex.en: I don't always do it that way.

items.en: to come from (a place); From: (in email header)

ex.zh: 我知道他来自哪里。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào tā lái zì nǎ lǐ
ex.en: I know where he comes from.

ex.zh: 你真的来自这里？
ex.p: nǐ zhēn de lái zì zhè lǐ
ex.en: Are you really from here?

ex.zh: 一个男的突然出现在门口。
ex.p: yī gè nán de tū rán chū xiàn zài mén kǒu
ex.en: A man suddenly appeared in the doorway.

ex.zh: 我们的火车突然停了下来。
ex.p: wǒ men de huǒ chē tū rán tíng le xià lai
ex.en: Our train stopped suddenly.

ex.zh: 他在这儿住了有一段时间了。
ex.p: tā zài zhèr zhù le yǒu yī duàn shí jiān le
ex.en: He lived here for a time.

ex.zh: 我看了他一段时间。
ex.p: wǒ kàn le tā yī duàn shí jiān
ex.en: I looked after him for a period of time.

ex.zh: 你最好检查一下这个。
ex.p: nǐ zuì hǎo jiǎn chá yī xià zhè gè
ex.en: You'd better check this out.

ex.zh: 你最近检查视力了吗？
ex.p: nǐ zuì jìn jiǎn chá shì lì le ma
ex.en: Have you had your eyesight checked recently?

items.en: to feel happy; to rejoice; to have a great time

ex.zh: 怎么了？你看上去不太开心。
ex.p: zěn me le nǐ kàn shang qu bù tài kāi xīn
ex.en: What's wrong? You don't look too happy.

ex.zh: 我们昨晚过得非常开心。
ex.p: wǒ men zuó wǎn guò de fēi cháng kāi xīn
ex.en: We had a very good time last night.

ex.zh: 路中间有一辆卡车。
ex.p: lù zhōng jiān yǒu yī liàng kǎ chē
ex.en: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.

ex.zh: 我的拉链卡住了。
ex.p: wǒ de lā liàn kǎ zhù le
ex.en: My zipper got stuck.

ex.zh: 我还不知道你明不明白。
ex.p: wǒ hái bù zhī dào nǐ míng bù míng bai
ex.en: I wonder if you understand.

ex.zh: 人应该明白世界在变。
ex.p: rén yīng gāi míng bai shì jiè zài biàn
ex.en: People should understand that the world is changing.

items.en: to do; to manage; to handle

ex.zh: 如果这是真的，您要怎么办？
ex.p: rú guǒ zhè shì zhēn de nín yào zěn me bàn
ex.en: If that were true, what would you do?

ex.zh: 下午请到我办公室来。
ex.p: xià wǔ qǐng dào wǒ bàn gōng shì lái
ex.en: Please come to my office in the afternoon.

ex.zh: 下个月我们会有辆新车。
ex.p: xià gè yuè wǒ men huì yǒu liàng xīn chē
ex.en: We're getting a new car next month.

ex.zh: 他帮我打到一辆出租车。
ex.p: tā bāng wǒ dá dào yī liàng chū zū chē
ex.en: He found me a taxi.

items.en: just recently; just a moment ago

ex.zh: 你刚刚说的，我完全没听明白。
ex.p: nǐ gāng gang shuō de wǒ wán quán méi yǐn míng bai
ex.en: I didn't understand anything you just said.

ex.zh: 刚刚发生了什么？
ex.p: gāng gang fā shēng le shén me
ex.en: What just happened?

ex.zh: 你觉得我的工作简单吗？
ex.p: nǐ jué de wǒ de gōng zuò jiǎn dān ma
ex.en: Do you think that my work is easy?

ex.zh: 您可以简单点儿说吗？
ex.p: nín kě yǐ jiǎn dān diǎn ér shuō ma
ex.en: Could you put it in plain language?

ex.zh: 能为你服务我会感到非常高兴。
ex.p: néng wèi nǐ fú wù wǒ huì gǎn dào fēi cháng gāo xìng
ex.en: I'll be very happy if I can serve you.

ex.zh: 我是服务员。
ex.p: wǒ shì fú wù yuán
ex.en: I'm a waiter.

items.en: straight; erect; to stick out (a part of the body)

ex.zh: 我挺喜欢那个歌手的。
ex.p: wǒ tǐng xǐ huan nà gè gē shǒu de
ex.en: I like that singer a lot.

ex.zh: 上次我见到她的时候，她看上去挺好的。
ex.p: shàng cì wǒ jiàn dào tā de shí hou tā kàn shang qu tǐng hǎo de
ex.en: She looked well when I last saw her.

Conditions

Grammar focus: 如果…就…; 只要…就…

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.p: shén me shí hou xiǎng lái jiù guò lái ba
sents.en: Come whenever you want.

sents.zh: 他很快就适应了新环境。
sents.p: tā hěn kuài jiù shì yìng le xīn huán jìng

sents.p: wǒ běn lái xiǎng zǒu de dàn hòu lái wàng le

sents.zh: 她对她的孩子非常生气。

sents.zh: 我们学校离公园非常近。
sents.p: wǒ men xué xiào chī gōng yuán fēi cháng jìn
sents.en: Our school is very close to the park.

sents.zh: 为什么你的嘴那么大？
sents.p: wèi shén me nǐ de zuǐ nà me dà
sents.en: Why is your mouth so big?

sents.zh: 嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。
sents.p: zuǐ lǐ yǒu dōng xī de shí hou bù zhǔn shuō huà
sents.en: Don't talk with your mouth full.

sents.zh: 我在回家的路上遇到了他。
sents.p: wǒ zài huí jiā de lù shang yù dào le tā
sents.en: I met him on my way home.

sents.zh: 你认为我们会遇到好天气吗？
sents.p: nǐ rèn wéi wǒ men huì yù dào hǎo tiān qì ma
sents.en: Do you think we'll have good weather?

sents.zh: 你不能喝海水，因为它太咸了。
sents.p: nǐ bù néng hē hǎi shuǐ yīn wèi tā tài xián le
sents.en: You can't drink seawater because it's too salty.

sents.zh: 那些海报现在都到哪里去了？
sents.p: nà xiē hǎi bào xiàn zài dōu dào nǎ lǐ qù le
sents.en: Where are those posters now?

sents.zh: 我感觉我的心跳得很快。
sents.p: wǒ gǎn jué wǒ de xīn tiào de hěn kuài
sents.en: I felt my heart beating rapidly.

sents.zh: 我的心跳得那么快！
sents.p: wǒ de xīn tiào de nà me kuài
sents.en: My heart's beating so fast!

sents.zh: 只有你回答了这个问题。
sents.p: zhǐ yǒu nǐ huí dá le zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: Only you answered the question.

sents.zh: 我可以回答所有问题。
sents.p: wǒ kě yǐ huí dá suǒ yǒu wèn tí
sents.en: I could answer all the questions.

sents.zh: 他把这记在他的笔记本上。
sents.p: tā bǎ zhè jì zài tā de bǐ jì běn shǎng
sents.en: He wrote it down in his notebook.

sents.zh: 我忘记他叫什么名字了。
sents.p: wǒ wàng jì tā jiào shén me míng zi le
sents.en: I forgot what his name was.

sents.zh: 我感觉大家都在关注我。
sents.p: wǒ gǎn jué dà jiā dōu zài guān zhù wǒ
sents.en: I feel like everybody's watching me.

sents.zh: 他不太关注棒球。
sents.p: tā bù tài guān zhù bàng qiú
sents.en: He doesn't care much for baseball.

sents.zh: 孩子们应该每天喝牛奶。
sents.p: hái zi men yīng gāi měi tiān hē niú nǎi
sents.en: Children should drink milk every day.

sents.zh: 现在女生穿牛仔裤很流行。
sents.p: xiàn zài nǚ shēng chuān niú zǎi kù hěn liú xíng
sents.en: Jeans are now in fashion among girls.

sents.zh: 有一天，我会跑得像风一样快。
sents.p: yǒu yī tiān wǒ huì páo de xiàng fēng yī yàng kuài
sents.en: Someday I'll run like the wind.

sents.zh: 昨天一点风也没有。
sents.p: zuó tiān yī diǎn fēng yě méi yǒu
sents.en: There was no wind at all yesterday.

sents.zh: 我会在我的办公室里。
sents.p: wǒ huì zài wǒ de bàn gōng shì lǐ
sents.en: I'll be in my office.

sents.zh: 我明天十点起会在办公室里。
sents.p: wǒ míng tiān shí diǎn qǐ huì zài bàn gōng shì lǐ
sents.en: I'll be in my office from ten tomorrow.

sents.zh: 你用你的照相机做了什么？
sents.p: nǐ yòng nǐ de zhào xiàng jī zuò le shén me
sents.en: What did you do with your camera?

sents.zh: 爸爸给我买了一个照相机。
sents.p: bà ba gěi wǒ mǎi le yī gè zhào xiàng jī
sents.en: Dad bought me a camera.

sents.zh: 我适应新环境很慢。
sents.p: wǒ shì yìng xīn huán jìng hěn màn
sents.en: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.

sents.zh: 你一点方向感都没有。
sents.p: nǐ yī diǎn fāng xiàng gǎn dōu méi yǒu
sents.en: You have no sense of direction.

sents.zh: 你的方向感很好。
sents.p: nǐ de fāng xiàng gǎn hěn hǎo
sents.en: You have a really good sense of direction.

sents.zh: 我很关心他的健康。
sents.p: wǒ hěn guān xīn tā de jiàn kāng
sents.en: I am very concerned about his health.

sents.zh: 你关心他们在想什么吗？
sents.p: nǐ guān xīn tā men zài xiǎng shén me ma
sents.en: Do you care what they think?

sents.zh: 这样做你能节约几个小时。
sents.p: zhè yàng zuò nǐ néng jié yuē jī gè xiǎo shí
sents.en: If you do it this way, you can save several hours.

sents.zh: 今天是情人节
sents.p: jīn tiān shì qíng rén jiē
sents.en: Today is Valentine's Day.

sents.zh: 我爱千层面。
sents.p: wǒ ài qiān céng miàn
sents.en: I love lasagna.

sents.zh: 医生给他的病人开了一些药。
sents.p: yī shēng gěi tā de bìng rén kāi le yī xiē yào
sents.en: The physician prescribed his patient some medicine.

units.title: Contrast
units.intro: Grammar focus: 虽然…但是…; 可是; 不过

ex.zh: 这只不过全是个大误会而已。
ex.p: zhè zhǐ bù guò quán shì gè dà wù huì ér yǐ
ex.en: It's all just a big misunderstanding.

ex.zh: 他不过是个孩子。
ex.p: tā bù guò shì gè hái zi
ex.en: He is but a child.

items.en: although; even though (often used correlatively with 是 or 是 etc)

ex.zh: 虽然他很有钱，但他不幸福。
ex.p: suī rán tā hěn yǒu qián dàn tā bù xìng fú
ex.en: He's rich, but he's not happy.

ex.zh: 虽然正在下雪，但是我也非去不可。
ex.p: suī rán zhèng zài xià xuě dàn shì wǒ yě fēi qù bù kě
ex.en: Although it is snowing, I must go.

ex.zh: 我的腿有什么毛病？
ex.p: wǒ de tuǐ yǒu shén me máo bìng
ex.en: What's wrong with my legs?

ex.zh: 你有着漂亮的腿。
ex.p: nǐ yǒu zhe piào liang de tuǐ
ex.en: You have beautiful legs.

ex.zh: 我在街上遇到他。
ex.p: wǒ zài jiē shǎng yù dào tā
ex.en: I met him on the street.

ex.zh: 我家离这里五个街区远。
ex.p: wǒ jiā chī zhè lǐ wǔ gè jiē oū yuǎn
ex.en: My house is five blocks away.

items.en: one side; either side; on the one hand

ex.zh: 他一边唱歌一边工作。
ex.p: tā yī biān chàng gē yī biān gōng zuò
ex.en: He sang while working.

ex.zh: 你很快就会习惯住在这里。
ex.p: nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn zhù zài zhè lǐ
ex.en: You'll get used to living here in no time.

ex.zh: 我现在已经习惯它了。
ex.p: wǒ xiàn zài yǐ jīng xí guàn tā le
ex.en: I'm used to it by now.

items.en: (intransitive) to change; to vary; change; variation

ex.zh: 你下个周末有什么安排？
ex.p: nǐ xià gè zhōu mò yǒu shén me ān pái
ex.en: What do you have planned for next weekend?

ex.zh: 我爸爸会在这周末回家。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba huì zài zhè zhōu mò huí jiā
ex.en: My father will come home at the end of this week.

items.en: to hear (sth said); one hears (that); hearsay

ex.zh: 从没有人听说过这件事。
ex.p: cóng méi yǒu rén tīng shuō guò zhè jiàn shì
ex.en: Nobody had ever heard of it.

ex.zh: 我从没听说过这个演员。
ex.p: wǒ cóng méi tīng shuō guò zhè gè yǎn yuán
ex.en: I've never heard of this actor.

ex.zh: 我会等在这儿直到他回来。
ex.p: wǒ huì děng zài zhèr zhí dào tā huí lai
ex.en: I'll wait here till he comes back.

ex.zh: 我想你待在这里直到我回来。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng nǐ dāi zài zhè lǐ zhí dào wǒ huí lai
ex.en: I want you to stay here until I get back.

ex.zh: 你觉得这件毛衣怎么样？
ex.p: nǐ jué de zhè jiàn máo yī zěn me yàng
ex.en: What do you think of this sweater?

ex.zh: 请问下，这件毛衣要多少钱？
ex.p: qǐng wèn xià zhè jiàn máo yī yào duō shǎo qián
ex.en: Excuse me, how much is this sweater?

ex.zh: 我永远不会忘记您的帮助。
ex.p: wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù huì wàng jì nín de bāng zhù
ex.en: I'll never forget how helpful you've been.

ex.zh: 他忘记给她买过一个礼物了。
ex.p: tā wàng jì gěi tā mǎi guò yī gè lǐ wù le
ex.en: He forgot that he bought her a present.

ex.zh: 看起来我们是在一条船上。
ex.p: kàn qǐ lai wǒ men shì zài yī tiáo chuán shǎng
ex.en: It seems we are in the same boat.

ex.zh: 船和火车哪个跑得快？
ex.p: chuán hé huǒ chē nǎ gè páo de kuài
ex.en: Which goes faster, a ship or a train?

items.en: to raise (animals); to bring up (children); to keep (pets)

ex.zh: 他们收养了那个小女孩。
ex.p: tā men shōu yǎng le nà gè xiǎo nǚ hái
ex.en: They adopted the little girl.

ex.zh: 我们今天得去养老院唱歌。
ex.p: wǒ men jīn tiān de qù yǎng lǎo yuàn chàng gē
ex.en: We have to sing at an old folks home today.

ex.zh: 不好意思，请问鸡蛋在哪儿？
ex.p: bù hǎo yì si qǐng wèn jī dàn zài nǎr
ex.en: Excuse me. Where are the eggs?

ex.zh: 我买了几个鸡蛋和一点牛奶。
ex.p: wǒ mǎi le jī gè jī dàn hé yī diǎn niú nǎi
ex.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.

ex.zh: 他把信读了一遍又一遍。
ex.p: tā bǎ xìn dòu le yī biàn yòu yī biàn
ex.en: He read the letter over and over.

ex.zh: 不好意思，能请您重复一遍吗？
ex.p: bù hǎo yì si néng qǐng nín chóng fù yī biàn ma
ex.en: I beg your pardon?

ex.zh: 你几点离开办公室？
ex.p: nǐ jī diǎn lí kāi bàn gōng shì
ex.en: What time will you leave the office?

ex.zh: 学生们在教室里。
ex.p: xué sheng men zài jiào shì lǐ
ex.en: The students are in the classroom.

ex.zh: 北极熊正在死去。
ex.p: běi jí xióng zhèng zài sǐ qù
ex.en: The polar bears are dying.

ex.zh: 她的英语好极了。
ex.p: tā de yīng yǔ hǎo jí le
ex.en: Her English is excellent.

items.en: we or us (including both the speaker and the person(s) spoken to)

ex.zh: 咱们吃吧！我饿死了。
ex.p: zán men chī ba wǒ è sǐ le
ex.en: Let's eat now. I'm starving.

ex.zh: 这都是咱们听说的。
ex.p: zhè dōu shì zán men tīng shuō de
ex.en: That’s what we heard.

ex.zh: 我不知道该怎么办。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn
ex.en: I have no idea of what to do.

ex.zh: 我们现在怎么办？
ex.p: wǒ men xiàn zài zěn me bàn
ex.en: What do we do now?

ex.p: nǐ zài nán guò ma
ex.en: Are you sad?

items.en: not long (after); before too long; soon

ex.zh: 不久就要吃正餐了。
ex.p: bù jiǔ jiù yào chī zhēng cān le
ex.en: It'll soon be time for dinner.

ex.zh: 可能不久会见你
ex.p: kě néng bù jiǔ huì jiàn nǐ
ex.en: Maybe I'll see you later.

ex.zh: 她给客人看了她的宝宝。
ex.p: tā gěi kè rén kàn le tā de bǎo bao
ex.en: She showed the visitor her baby.

ex.zh: 那家店有很多客人。
ex.p: nà jiā diàn yǒu hěn duō kè rén
ex.en: That shop has many customers.

ex.zh: 他常常坐着看书一连好几个小时。
ex.p: tā cháng cháng zuò zhe kàn shū yī lián hǎo jī gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: He often sits for many hours reading books.

ex.zh: 我爸爸常常洗碗。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba cháng cháng xǐ wǎn
ex.en: My father often washes the dishes.

items.en: ordinarily; in normal times; in peacetime

ex.zh: 今天比平时还忙。
ex.p: jīn tiān bǐ píng shí hái máng
ex.en: Today's even busier than normal.

ex.zh: 大多数男生喜欢电脑游戏。
ex.p: dà duō shù nán shēng xǐ huan diàn nǎo yóu xì
ex.en: Most boys like computer games.

ex.zh: 这个班有多少男生？
ex.p: zhè gè bān yǒu duō shǎo nán shēng
ex.en: How many boys are in this class?

ex.zh: 我的工作是洗碗。
ex.p: wǒ de gōng zuò shì xǐ wǎn
ex.en: My job is to wash dishes.

ex.zh: 洗碗是我的工作。
ex.p: xǐ wǎn shì wǒ de gōng zuò
ex.en: My job is to wash the dishes.

items.en: to understand; to know; to comprehend

ex.zh: 好久没有休一个真正的假期了。

ex.en: It's been a long time since I've had a real vacation.

ex.zh: 我好久不见他了。
ex.p: wǒ hǎo jiǔ bù jiàn tā le
ex.en: I've not seen him in a long time.

ex.zh: 夏天过得怎么样？
ex.p: xià tiān guò de zěn me yàng
ex.en: How was your summer?

ex.zh: 我们整个夏天都和他们待在一起。
ex.p: wǒ men zhěng gè xià tiān dōu hé tā men dāi zài yī qǐ
ex.en: We stayed with them all through the summer.

ex.zh: 他喜欢数学，但我不喜欢。
ex.p: tā xǐ huan shù xué dàn wǒ bù xǐ huan
ex.en: He likes math, but I don't.

ex.zh: 大多数学生步行去学校。
ex.p: dà duō shù xué sheng bù xíng qù xué xiào
ex.en: Most students walk to school.

items.en: to brush; to paint; to daub

ex.zh: 他把他的自行车刷成红色。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā de zì xíng chē shuā chéng hóng sè
ex.en: He painted his bicycle red.

ex.zh: 他把天花板刷成了蓝色。
ex.p: tā bǎ tiān huā bǎn shuā chéng le lán sè
ex.en: He painted the ceiling blue.

ex.zh: 我的两个姐妹都结婚了。
ex.p: wǒ de liǎng gè jiě mèi dōu jié hūn le
ex.en: Both of my sisters are married.

ex.zh: 几乎没有人认为我们是姐妹。
ex.p: jī hū méi yǒu rén rèn wéi wǒ men shì jiě mèi
ex.en: Almost nobody thinks we're sisters.
